description: Critical path (CPM/PERT) project schedule — Critical Path Method for any task list. tasks=id:duration[:dep1,dep2];... (finish-to-start dependencies) or PERT three-point id:optimistic/likely/pessimistic[:deps]. Returns project duration, critical path(s), early/late start and finish, total and free float, near-critical tasks, max parallel work. PERT mode adds expected duration, critical-path sd, a seeded beta-PERT Monte Carlo (P50/P80/P90/P95, criticality index per task). Optional: deadline= (probability of finishing on time), start=YYYY-MM-DD for calendar dates (workdays=false to count weekends), units=, sims=, seed=. Detects cycles and unknown dependencies. Offline, max 300 tasks. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_critical_path
